ai.title: Refine system prompt editing instructions
ai.summary: Updated `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to clarify file modification guidelines. Replaced verbose constraints with a bulleted list emphasizing concise context, placeholder comments for imports, and avoiding unnecessary code reproduction. Added logic to recognize when requested changes already exist in fetched files.

eli5.text: The instructions that guide how files get edited were rewritten to be more straightforward and easier to follow. Instead of long, detailed rules, the guidance now uses short bullet points that emphasize keeping edits concise and using clear placeholder marks for existing code. This affects anyone giving editing instructions to an AI assistant, making it less likely that unchanged parts of a file get accidentally removed when a small change is requested. If you looked, you would notice shorter, clearer guidance and smarter behavior that can recognize when a requested change may have already been applied.

ai.title: System prompt cleanup: punctuation and knowledge file simplification
ai.summary: Added trailing periods to list items in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` for grammatical consistency. Simplified `knowledgeFilesPrompt` by removing the distinction between directory-level and file-specific knowledge files, replacing it with a unified definition. Scope limited to backend system prompt configuration. The change reduces prompt verbosity and potential ambiguity regarding knowledge file types.

eli5.text: The internal instructions that guide how the assistant works got tidied up: the checklist items now end with proper punctuation for consistency, and the guidance about project notes no longer splits them into two categories, instead treating all notes the same way. This is behind-the-scenes cleanup to the assistant's rulebook, so nothing you see or do is affected.

ai.title: Version bump to 1.0.64
ai.summary: Version bumped from 1.0.63 to 1.0.64. Covers backend/package.json and npm-app/package.json. No functional changes.

eli5.text: Your device received a routine update that simply marks the software as a new version, like putting a fresh label on a box without changing anything inside. This keeps automatic update systems able to detect and install new releases correctly. There are no visible features, fixes, or behavior changes to notice this time.

ai.title: Fix NodeJS.Timeout type error in websocket client
ai.summary: Reverted `NodeJS.Timeout` to `NodeJS.Timer` in `common/src/websockets/websocket-client.ts`. Addresses type error in `OutstandingTxn`, `connectTimeout`, and `heartbeat` fields. Internal type fix for shared websocket client.

eli5.text: The app fixed a behind-the-scenes typing mistake in its live connection code that handled real-time messages between your device and the company's servers. This kind of error only shows up to the programmers building the app, not to regular users, so you wouldn't notice anything different in your day-to-day use. The fix simply swaps one internal label for another so the code stays consistent and avoids confusing the tools that check the software for problems.

ai.title: Fix drizzle config paths and remove unused import
ai.summary: Drizzle config paths switched to relative strings. Removes `__dirname` usage in `common/src/db/drizzle.config.ts`. Fixes local error. `web/src/app/layout.tsx` drops unused `ThemeSwitcher` import.

eli5.text: When you run the database migration tool locally, it will now correctly find its configuration files instead of throwing an error. The tool previously used a path that broke outside the project folder, so it has been updated to use paths relative to the project root. Separately, the main web page template stopped importing an unused theme toggle component, which slightly reduces the page load bundle size and prevents an unused-code warning.

ai.title: Rename agent Manny to Mani
ai.summary: Agent name updated from Manny to Mani across system prompt, docs, and UI. Files touched: backend/src/system-prompt.ts, knowledge.md, npm-app/knowledge.md, web/src/app/page.tsx, web/src/lib/constant.ts. Minor formatting tweaks in constant.ts and knowledge.md. Internal branding change only.

eli5.text: The AI coding assistant inside Manicode now introduces itself as 'Mani' instead of 'Manny' wherever you see it described. This is purely a rename of the assistant's display name and brand-facing identity. The assistant's actual capabilities, the help it provides, and how it works haven't changed at all. You'd notice this if you looked at the project's description in the browser tab, the homepage copy describing the assistant, or the internal system prompt it was written with. The change went out today (2024-09-21) and is live for anyone who loads the web interface or reads the public project documentation (knowledge.md). All references to the assistant in the visible UI and documentation now use 'Mani', and the assistant now identifies as 'Mani' in its own introductory prompt. No
